snippet.title: Silver Daze - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Silver Daze is a retro style coming-of-age JRPG filled with unique characters and thrilling battles. launching on September 26, 2025!

Play the Demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3097590/Silver_Daze_Demo/
